title: The Cost of an Unknown Horizon for the Last Iterate of Clipped SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise
abstract: arXiv:2610.33381v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training is often stopped at a data-dependent time, so guarantees for the last iterate must hold at all times simultaneously. We determine the optimal time-uniform rate for the last iterate of clipped SGD on smooth convex objectives under heavy-tailed noise with a bounded central $p$th moment, $1\beta_p$, even with adaptive step sizes and thresholds. This rate lies between the optimal rate $O(T^{-\alpha_p})$ for a known horizon $T$, $\alpha_p=(p-1)/p$, and the previous time-uniform rate $\tilde O(t^{-2(p-1)/(3p)})$ (Chezhegov et al., ICLR 2026); under finite variance, the exponents are $1/2$, $2/5$, and $1/3$. Their conjecture that a better schedule reaches the optimal rate thus holds with a known horizon (Liu; Jiang et al.) but fails without one. Querying gradients at the running average attains $\tilde O(t^{-\alpha_p})$ at all times, whereas heavy-ball momentum with geometric forgetting and polynomially bounded steps cannot improve on

translated_title: 重尾噪声下裁剪SGD最后迭代点在未知时域中的代价
translated_abstract: 训练过程通常在依赖于数据的时间点停止，因此对最后迭代点的保证必须在所有时间点上同时成立。我们确定了在具有有界中心p阶矩的重尾噪声下，裁剪SGD在光滑凸目标函数上最后迭代点的最优时间一致收敛率，即使使用自适应步长和自适应阈值也同样成立。该收敛率介于已知时域T时的最优收敛率O(T^{-α_p})（其中α_p=(p-1)/p）与先前的时间一致收敛率Õ(t^{-2(p-1)/(3p)})（Chezhegov等人，ICLR 2026）之间；在方差有限的情形下，这三个指数分别为1/2、2/5和1/3。因此，关于采用更好的调度策略可以达到最优收敛率的猜想，在已知时域的情况下成立（Liu；Jiang等人），但在未知时域的情况下并不成立。在运行平均处查询梯度可以在所有时间点上达到Õ(t^{-α_p})的最优速率，而具有几何遗忘特性的heavy-ball动量法与多项式有界的步长则无法对此进行改进。
tldr: 本文确定了重尾噪声下裁剪SGD最后迭代点在未知（数据依赖）停止时间下的最优时间一致收敛率，证明该速率严格劣于已知时域时的最优速率，且heavy-ball动量等方法无法弥补这一差距，而在运行平均处查询梯度则可达到最优速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the optimal time-uniform convergence rate for the last iterate of clipped SGD under heavy-tailed noise with an unknown (data-dependent) stopping time, showing this rate is strictly worse than the known-horizon optimum and cannot be improved by heavy-ball momentum, while querying gradients at running averages achieves the optimal rate.
